govt_offices.name: Bangalore One Citizen Service Centre — MG Road

govt_offices.services: Electricity & Water Bill Payment, Property Tax, RTC/Pahani, Caste/Income Certificate, Bus Pass, Police Verification
govt_offices.route_guide: From Central MG Circle, proceed 250m East along MG Road Boulevard. Located on ground concourse near Exit A.

govt_offices.address: BDA Complex Ground Floor, 4th Block Jayanagar, Bengaluru 560011
govt_offices.services: BESCOM & BWSSB Bills, Aadhaar Card Services, Trade License, Senior Citizen Cards, Challan Payments
govt_offices.route_guide: Head South on 11th Main towards 4th Block BDA Complex. Entry via Main Gate West.

govt_offices.address: BBMP Ward Office Complex, 80 Feet Road, 6th Block Koramangala, Bengaluru 560095

govt_offices.name: UIDAI Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) — Indiranagar
govt_offices.address: 100 Feet Road, Near Domlur Flyover Junction, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038
govt_offices.services: Fresh Aadhaar Enrolment, Biometric Update (Fingerprint/Iris/Photo), Mobile Number Link, Name/Address Change, Child Biometrics
govt_offices.route_guide: From Old Airport Road, turn onto 100 Feet Road. Located 150m from Domlur Flyover on the service lane.

govt_offices.name: Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) — South Bengaluru Central
govt_offices.address: 3rd Floor, Manipal Centre Wing, Bannerghatta Main Road, Bengaluru 560076

govt_offices.route_guide: Follow Bannerghatta Main Road South towards Dairy Circle. Facility is on the 3rd floor with basement parking.

govt_offices.name: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) Head Office
govt_offices.services: Civic grievance escalations, Khata Registration, Property Tax disputes, Town Planning & Public Works
govt_offices.route_guide: Take Kasturba Road onto Corporation Circle. Main gateway faces Hudson Memorial Church.

govt_offices.name: Bengaluru Urban Deputy Commissioner & Revenue Office
govt_offices.address: Kandaya Bhavan, KG Road, Gandhi Nagar, Bengaluru 560009
govt_offices.services: Caste & Income Certificates, RTC Bhoomi Land records, Domicile verification, Voter ID registration
govt_offices.route_guide: Head north from Mysore Bank Circle up KG Road for 300m. Kandaya Bhavan is on the left wing.

govt_offices.name: Regional Transport Office (RTO) Central — Jayanagar
govt_offices.services: Learner's & Driving License (Sarathi), Vehicle Registration (Vahan), Fitness Certificate, Road Tax
govt_offices.route_guide: Proceed along 8th Block main road. Test track and vehicle inspection bay on the east gate.
